meaning:
παρ-αυτίκα
adv. (πάραυτα = παρ ̓ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα) [in LXX: Psa.70:3, Tob.4:14 * ;]
1. immediately.
2. C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), momentary, for a moment: 2Co.4:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
